title: queue.md's own shape will fail the findings-queue checks it declares
body: queue.md is a jot log with no evidence or review column, and the repository declares the findings-queue module against it. Reshaping it into the specified table and keeping the jot log are both defensible; the choice is owed before the audit at milestone 2b reports it.

title: One of the three promised open design questions is missing
body: Pull request #1's body promises three open design questions in docs/ui-surfaces.md. The file marks two, on the composer and on records. The third is either unwritten or was retired without a note.

title: A paused metering change would decide the adapter's exposure
body: Anthropic's paused metering change, support article 15036540, would move headless and Agent SDK usage off plan limits and onto separate credits if it un-pauses. Which invocation path the per-machine adapter uses then decides what Mustur costs to run. A candidate limitation row in Plan.md, not yet written there.

title: The export and this repository's contract files hold the same records twice
body: records/ now carries the same decisions and findings as decisions.md and queue.md, one addressable and one prose. Milestone 2b should decide whether this repository's own StrucGu roles move to the export or stay on the files a person edits.

title: A seeded record's summary can drift from the prose it links to
body: Each seeded record carries one line summarising a rationale that lives in a contract file. Nothing compares the two, so an edit to the prose leaves the summary standing. A check is cheap and nobody has asked for one.

title: The Go toolchain CI uses is whatever the runner image carries
body: make check needs Go once milestone 2 lands, and the Makefile cannot pin a toolchain. ci/proposed/ci.yml is what pins it; until the owner applies that proposal the version is the image's.

title: There is no way to add a record except by editing the bootstrap
body: Every decision taken since milestone 2 has reached the store by being added to the seed and re-exported from a scratch database. The seed refuses a store that already holds records, so the live store cannot take them at all: a bootstrap is being used as an import, which is exactly what it was built to refuse.

title: A commit removed lines from the decision log
body: An entry written earlier in the same milestone was rewritten in place rather than corrected by a later one. The branch was unmerged at the time, so nothing shipped had been edited, and the merged history carries the deletion anyway.

data.value: DL-03 against commit 9e3940e, on the audit's first run

title: Two standing rules disagree about where a superseding pointer goes
body: workflow.md says superseded decisions stay with a pointer, and that an entry is never edited. A pointer added to the superseded entry would be an edit of it, so only the later entry can carry one. The contract should say which.

data.value: workflow.md's standing rules, read against each other

title: Nothing checks that the mandate still says what milestone 1 scored
body: The clause in CLAUDE.md is prose a person edits, and no test, script or gate compares it to the fixture the disproof ran. A string comparison would be a few lines.

data.value: no gate matches the clause's opening words

title: No gate detects the export drifting from the store
body: The committed check runs mustur verify without a store, and CI has none to compare against. A hand edit to records/ is caught only by someone running verify with a store.

data.value: the verify-records target passes no store

title: ci/proposed/README.md says a new check needs no owner
body: Milestone 2's Go checks needed a workflow change the agent's token cannot push, and milestone 2b's catalog checkout needs another. That row has now been falsified twice.

title: Four of StrucGu's five roles are record kinds, and nobody has asked for the fifth
body: triage-rule describes a document rather than a set of records. Whether Mustur should hold a triage rule as a record at all is unasked.

data.value: the record kinds in internal/ident, against StrucGu's module list
